effects.instruction: Narrator only, today's plan (do not foreshadow anything beyond it): the Paranormal Liberation War: before dawn the licensed Hero Course students are woken and sent out with the pros for a nationwide raid, briefed on the way: most hold the Gunga Mountain Villa perimeter under Midnight and the raid's heroes, others help evacuate Jaku City. There are no classes; a student without a license stays at U.A., which is locked down.
